an9.83:2.1: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ sikkhā dubbalyānaṃ pahānāya cattāro iddhipādā bhāvetabbā.
an9.83:2.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti.
an9.83:2.7: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ sikkhādubbalyānaṃ pahānāya ime cattāro iddhipādā bhāvetabbāti.
